text: I was hurt in a car accident in Perth. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Perth. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

items.markdown:
If you were hurt in a car accident in Perth, you will generally be dealing with `Western Australia’s Compulsory Third Party (CTP) insurance scheme` , managed by the Insurance Commission of Western Australia (ICWA). Because CTP claims involve strict fault evaluations, medical assessments, and time limits (typically a 3-year limitation period from the date of the accident to settle or commence court proceedings), getting specialized legal representation can protect your entitlements.[[1]](https://www.millnerknight.com.au/motor-vehicle-accidents/wa/)[[2]](https://dangelolegal.law/services/motor-vehicle-accident/)

Many well-established compensation and personal injury law firms in Perth operate on a **No Win, No Fee** basis (though you should always check the fine print regarding third-party disbursements/out-of-pocket costs).[[1]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/motor-vehicle-accidents)[[2]](https://dangelolegal.law/services/motor-vehicle-accident/)

### Prominent Compensation Law Firms in Perth

- Maurice Blackburn Lawyers (Perth Office) – Located on Victoria Avenue in Perth, they handle road and car injury claims through ICWA's fault-based or catastrophic schemes, offering free initial claim checks.[[1]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/road-injury/car-accident-lawyers-perth/)[[2]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/our-offices/wa/perth/)[[3]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/road-injury/car-accident/)
- Slater and Gordon Lawyers (Perth) – Located in Cathedral Square, they specialize in CTP motor vehicle claims, covering loss of income, medical care, and lump-sum impairment benefits with initial obligation-free consultations.[[1]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/motor-vehicle-accidents/car-accident-lawyers-in-perth)
- [Shine Lawyers (Perth Office)](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/wa/perth) – Located on Hay Street, they manage motor vehicle and road accident compensation claims on a no-win, no-fee framework, with options for virtual, phone, or in-office appointments.[[1]](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/wa/perth)
- **Boutique & Local Specialists** (such as *D'Angelo Legal* or *WA Law Group* ) – Local WA firms also focus specifically on motor vehicle accident legislation and ICWA dispute management.[[1]](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/motor-vehicle-accident/wa/perth-6000)[[2]](https://dangelolegal.law/services/motor-vehicle-accident/)

### Immediate Steps to Keep in Mind

1. **Notify ICWA and Police:** Ensure the crash has been reported to Western Australia Police and that you have lodged or started the process of notifying ICWA.[[1]](https://www.millnerknight.com.au/motor-vehicle-accidents/wa/)
2. **Book a Free Consultation:** Most of the major firms listed above offer a free initial consultation to review the specifics of your accident and determine if you have a viable claim for medical expenses, lost wages, or pain and suffering.[[1]](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/wa/perth)[[2]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/motor-vehicle-accidents/car-accident-lawyers-in-perth)[[3]](https://dangelolegal.law/services/motor-vehicle-accident/)[[4]](https://www.millnerknight.com.au/motor-vehicle-accidents/wa/)

If you'd like to narrow this down, please let me know:

- **Who** was at fault (or if liability is disputed)
- **What kind of injuries** you sustained

I can help you prepare questions for your initial consultation or outline what documentation you should gather.
